title: Freehand, which builds AI agents to manage supply chain spend and operations for Fortune 500 companies, raised a $75M Series B, after a $25M Series A in 2024 (Mary Ann Azevedo/Crunchbase News)
summary: Mary Ann Azevedo / Crunchbase News: Freehand, which builds AI agents to manage supply chain spend and operations for Fortune 500 companies, raised a $75M Series B, after a $25M Series A in 2024 — Enterprise AI startup Freehand has raised $75 million in a Series B funding round to scale its autonomous AI agents …
